title: Bun Maska
description: A Hyderabadi Irani cafe favourite of soft pav lightly toasted and spread generously with butter, best with a cup of chai.
steps: Slit the pav horizontally without cutting through so it opens like a book.
Heat a tawa on low heat and warm the pav for a minute on each side.
Spread the butter generously inside each pav and sprinkle a little sugar over the butter.
Close and serve immediately with hot chai.
